profile_sync_desc: Manage your vault and cloud sync.
app_background_desc: Background tint for cards and panels across the app.
accent_color_desc: Used for primary buttons and sidebar icon highlights.
show_localhost_host_desc: Display the built-in local shell entry in the hosts list and sidebar.
terminal_font_family_desc: Monospace font used in terminal sessions.
security_desc: Lock or wipe your local vault.
lock_vault_desc: Require your password to open the app again.
touch_id_desc: Unlock the vault with biometrics on this device.
touch_id_password_hint: Enter your vault password to enable Touch ID.
wipe_data_desc: Permanently delete all hosts, keys, and settings on this device.
wipe_confirm_desc: This cannot be undone. Your vault and all saved hosts will be removed from this device.
